Privacy

terra.pura is a student project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Everything you enter stays on your own device, and we do nothing with it.

  • Your farm is saved only in your own browser. It never reaches our server.
  • We don't sell, share, analyse or advertise with anything, or train anything on it.
  • No accounts, no cookies, no tracking or analytics.
  • Clear it any time with Settings → Start over.

What stays in your browser

The land you draw, your providers, machinery, wages and the analysis are saved in your browser's local storage so the dashboard works when you come back. We can't see this. Clear it any time with Settings → Start over, or by clearing your browser data.

Automatic connection verification (VPN check)

This applies to the copy hosted by Sorila at terrapura.sorila.dev, as it does across all Sorila sites (not to copies you run yourself). As soon as you visit, our servers temporarily process your IP address to check if you are using a VPN (Virtual Private Network), which are prohibited for safety. This specific IP check is completely automated; no human sees this data, your location is not resolved, and the IP is only held for a few seconds to match against VPN databases before being discarded. It is not permanently stored in our active administration logs. See the Sorila privacy policy.

Data services the site talks to

To analyse your land, your browser sends your field's coordinates (nothing that identifies you) to public data services: NASA POWER, NASA GIBS and EONET, ISRIC SoilGrids, Open-Meteo, OpenStreetMap (Nominatim and Overpass), and in some countries postcodes.io, Octopus Energy, Red Eléctrica, the US PNNL and EPA map services and exchange-rate data. Map and satellite images load from OpenStreetMap, Esri and NASA. Each of those services has its own privacy policy. The full list is on the About page.
